title: Voyager 1 Is About to Be One Full Light-Day Away From Earth

scenes.text: Voyager 1 is about to be a full day away.
In mid-November it reaches one light-day from Earth, about 16 billion miles.
A radio signal already takes about 23 hours to get there. Soon it takes 24.
That's roughly 173 times farther from us than the Sun.
It launched in 1977, and it is still sending data.
Ask it a question today, and the answer takes two days.

description:
Voyager 1 is about to be a full day away.
In mid-November 2026 the 1977 probe reaches one light-day from Earth, about 16 billion miles.
What would you ask a spacecraft that is a light-day away?
first_comment: Voyager 1 launched in 1977. Did you know it's still talking to us?
